reddit.title: Introducing Materials Instead of Cost Badges in Provincia
reddit.body: We're excited to share a significant update in Provincia! Build tiles now display a detailed materials sheet instead of a single cost chip. This means you can easily see what materials you have versus what you need for each building. Shortages are highlighted, making planning much clearer. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges

steam.title: Provincia Update: Materials Management Revamp
steam.body: We're thrilled to announce a major update to Provincia! The build tiles now feature a materials sheet that provides a clear overview of what resources are stored and what is required for each building. No more guessing with cost badges! This new system allows you to plan your constructions more effectively. For full details on this update, visit: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges
